findings.title: Handoff integrity is incomplete for expiry and crash recovery
findings.observed: See exact deterministic observations in review_regressions1.json
findings.expected: Changing handoff expires_at must raise STATE_INVALID; changing URL after after_link checkpoint failure must raise STATE_INVALID instead of adopting attacker URL. Current first case returns link-verified with differing file/result expiration, second adopts attacker URL and records its digest.
findings.minimal_repair: Bind every contractual handoff field including expiry to durable task state; durably bind URL digest before exposing handoff/checkpoint so recovery validates rather than trusts first observed content. Keep valid crash recovery and original deadline unchanged.

findings.title: State permission and parent symlink validation are incomplete
findings.observed: See exact deterministic observations in review_regressions1.json
findings.expected: status on state directory chmod0755 must reject unsafe state. A preexisting remote-handoffs symlink to another private directory must be rejected before provider activity/private-file creation; currently deliver succeeds and writes handoff outside state.
findings.minimal_repair: Validate existing state ownership/private permissions in status and reject lexical symlink components of generated state subdirectories before following/chmod/reading/writing. Apply same necessary check to bundle/lock/handoff parents; no global ledger refactor required.

findings.title: Checkpoint exception and provider code can expose arbitrary sensitive text
findings.observed: See exact deterministic observations in review_regressions1.json
findings.expected: RuntimeError(PRIVATE_SENTINEL_CHECKPOINT) must become safe structured DeliveryError with safe persisted code; current exception propagates unchanged. DeliveryError(PRIVATE_SENTINEL_CODE,...) from provider must not use arbitrary text as return/error/DB last_error; currently marker survives both.
findings.minimal_repair: Wrap callback failures at remote boundary and normalize provider/callback error codes to known safe codes; preserve documented OSError=>IO_ERROR and REMOTE_UNKNOWN no-repeat behavior. Never store raw exception text/code that is outside controlled error vocabulary.

findings.title: Status still follows private-state subdirectory symlinks
findings.observed: After a normal delivery, move remote-handoffs or remote-bundles outside state and replace it with a symlink. status() returns link-verified and returns handoff/password path through that symlink. Both reproduced offline with synthetic provider.
findings.expected: Reject symlink components in the private paths status examines before following/returning them; unsafe state=>STATE_INVALID per AC6.
findings.minimal_repair: Apply read-only lexical component validation to handoff and password paths/status subdirectories. Do not create dirs or contact provider in status. Lock subtree not examined by status is not added as a new requirement.
findings.scope_relation: Residual affected surface of prior R1-PATHS, not a new feature or style request.
